(b) Why fog computing is needed (notes p.103–106): if all data were sent straight to the cloud for processing,
• last-mile bandwidth is very limited and cannot carry the huge volume of data;
• the round-trip delay is large, so real-time response is impossible;
• the gateway's backhaul link often relies on 3G/LTE or even satellite, and is unreliable;
• the backhaul and the data centre must handle too much data, and real-time analytics on big data gets harder and harder.
Fog computing distributes data processing to places near the network edge. Local analysis reduces latency, offloads the core network of a large amount of traffic, and keeps sensitive data local. Fog nodes are geographically close to the sensors and context-aware, can form distributed edge control loops, and compress/reduce the data before uploading it.
<b>(b) 五个难点</b>（讲义 Part B p.82–83）：<br>①:
(b) Five challenges (notes Part B p.82–83):
① Scalability: there can be millions of devices, and how the system supports them is the key issue; at the network layer, IPv6 can provide a huge number of addresses.
② Security: the more connected "things", the larger the attack surface; once a device is compromised, it can become a stepping stone for attacking other devices and systems.
③ Privacy: much of the data collected by sensors relates to specific individuals and their activities and may contain sensitive information and credentials; how to protect it and with whom to share it are key questions.

(ii) Why it is SIMO: there is only one transmitted symbol s (one transmit antenna) but two received signals y₁, y₂ (two receive antennas), each through a different channel gain h₁, h₂ with independent noise, so it is single-input multiple-output (1 × 2).
How diversity is obtained: the same s arrives over two paths that fade independently (if the antennas are far enough apart). When h₁ is in a deep fade, h₂ is most likely not; the probability that both fade deeply at once is the product of the individual probabilities, which is much smaller. The receiver combines the two branches, e.g. MRC: z = h₁*y₁ + h₂*y₂ = (|h₁|² + |h₂|²)s + noise. The effective gain is the sum of the two branches, and the diversity order is 2.

Each symbol is sent once from each of the two antennas over the two time slots, and reaches the receiver over two independently fading paths. The receiver uses the orthogonal structure to combine linearly; the decision statistic contains (|h₁|² + |h₂|²), and the probability that both paths are in a deep fade at the same time is small. With 2 transmit antennas and 1 receive antenna the diversity order is 2; with 2 transmit and M receive antennas it is 2M, i.e. full diversity N × M. Trade-off: it needs no channel knowledge at the transmitter, but compared with receive MRC it loses array gain (notes Ch5 p.30 "MRC has array gain over OSTBC & Alamouti code").

<b>TDMA（时分多址，Time Division Multiple Acce: TDMA (Time Division Multiple Access) is the reverse: everyone shares the same frequency, but time is cut into very short "time slots". Users take turns, each transmitting only in its assigned slot and staying silent the rest of the time. Because the slots are short and rotate quickly, the ear hardly notices the gaps, and the call feels continuous.

In one big group of 10, any idle channel can take any call, so busy and idle periods balance out. To keep the same 1% blocking, small groups must keep more spare capacity, so their average utilisation is lower. This is the trunking effect, like one queue for several bank counters being more efficient than a separate queue at each counter.

<b>加法</b>算\"或\"；A、B 互斥（不可能同时发生）时交集为 0，直接: Addition gives "or"; if A and B are mutually exclusive (cannot happen together), the intersection is 0 and you simply add. Multiplication gives "and": first A happens, then B happens given A. Total probability means "split into cases, then add up": take every possible case \(A_1, A_2,\dots\) (mutually exclusive, together covering everything), compute each one and weight it. Bayes goes the other way: you have already seen the result B and ask which case caused it.
<b>动态信道分配（DCA）</b>（p.95–96）：信道不永久分给小区；新呼: Dynamic channel assignment (DCA) (p.95–96): channels are not permanently assigned to cells. When a new call arrives, any base station may use any channel, chosen by some algorithm, as long as the co-channel interference constraint is met (the same channel cannot be reused within the reuse distance D). The algorithm is based on predicted future blocking, the reuse distance and other cost functions. Channel borrowing is one form of DCA. Heavily loaded cells can use more channels; flexible with low blocking, but needs centralised control and more computation.
<b>动态信道分配（DCA）</b>：信道不永久属于某个蜂窝，谁有需要、谁就可以: Dynamic channel assignment (DCA): channels do not belong permanently to any cell. Any cell that needs one can request any idle channel, as long as it does not violate the "co-channel interference constraint" (i.e. it cannot take a channel in use by a neighbour within the reuse distance). DCA is more flexible but needs a more complex central scheduling algorithm.
<b>动态分配 DCA</b>（dynamic，p.95）：信道不永久归某个小区: Dynamic channel assignment (DCA) (p.95): channels do not belong permanently to any cell; each new call picks an available channel by a rule, as long as the co-channel interference constraint is not violated. Channel borrowing is one form of DCA: a busy cell borrows from a neighbour and returns the channel when the call ends.

<b>隐藏节点</b>（hidden node）：A 发给 B，C 在 B 的范: Hidden node: A sends to B, and C is within B's range but outside A's range (p.48). C cannot hear A, thinks the channel is idle, transmits, and collides at B. ACKs alone cannot solve this: after a collision you can only retransmit, and the collisions keep repeating.

AP 先发 CF-Poll 给某个节点（自己有数据就把数据和 CF-Poll 捎: The AP first sends a CF-Poll to a node (if the AP has data for it, it piggybacks the data with the CF-Poll). The polled node replies with Data+CF-ACK or CF-ACK. When all nodes have been polled or the CFP time is up, the AP broadcasts CF-End (p.27). Superframe = contention-free period CFP + contention period CP, started by a DTIM beacon (p.28). The AP seizes the channel with PIFS, which is shorter than DIFS, so the CFP has higher priority and is not interrupted by the CP; priority order ACK > time-bounded packets > non-time-bounded data (p.29).

AP 再等一个 PIFS 抢到信道，发 Beacon：CFP 开始，所有站把 N: The AP waits one more PIFS, wins the channel and sends a Beacon: the CFP starts, and all stations set their NAV to the maximum.
AP 发 CF-Poll 给下一个站，但隔了 SIFS 都<b>没有回应</b>: The AP sends CF-Poll to the next station, but after SIFS there is no response; the AP waits one PIFS, takes back the channel and polls B.

AP 有数据给 STA1：把数据和轮询合成一帧 Data + CF-Poll 发: The AP has data for STA1: it combines the data and the poll into one frame, Data + CF-Poll (piggybacking).
AP 点 STA3：它没回应。AP 等一个 PIFS 就收回信道（比 DIFS: The AP polls STA3: no response. The AP waits one PIFS and takes the channel back (shorter than DIFS, so no one else can cut in).

The EPS uses bearers to carry IP traffic from the PDN gateway to the UE: a bearer is an IP packet flow with a defined QoS between the gateway and the UE, i.e. a logical connection. The E-UTRAN and EPC set up and release bearers as applications require; over the air interface the eNodeB guarantees the bearer's QoS.

MIMO 容量 = r 条子信道的容量之和，r 是秩，<b>不是 N × M</: MIMO capacity = sum of the capacities of r subchannels, where r is the rank, not N × M: some subchannels are correlated with each other and count as only one. SIMO and MISO have only one, so adding antennas does not multiply the capacity.

Noise is added at the receiver, one noise component per receive antenna. You must be able to write y<sub>m</sub> = Σ<sub>n</sub> h<sub>mn</sub>x<sub>n</sub> + v<sub>m</sub> and the matrix form directly.

That is the difficulty: the signal has not been sent yet, so the transmitter can only use the previous estimate fed back by the receiver, which requires a slowly varying channel. SIMO also needs channel information, but it is easier to estimate at the receiver.
MISO：发端知不知道信道: MISO: does the transmitter know the channel?
ML = 最小距离：量 y 到 4 个星座点的距离，最近的是 s₁（绿线）→ 判: ML = minimum distance: measure the distance from y to the 4 constellation points; the nearest is s₁ (green line) → correct decision.

ML 门限是两条似然曲线（两个 PDF）的交点，不一定在中点：哪一边噪声大，门限: The ML threshold is where the two likelihood curves (the two PDFs) cross, not necessarily at the midpoint: the threshold moves away from the side with the larger noise.
MLSE 的两个问题：复杂度 M<sup>K</sup>；要等整串符号收完才判决: Two problems with MLSE: complexity M<sup>K</sup>; and it must wait until the whole sequence is received before deciding, so the delay is large. MLSE 的维特比算法：只留幸存路径: Viterbi algorithm for MLSE: keep only the survivor paths
ML：比较两个似然。判 1 的条件是 \\(\\dfrac{1}{\\sigma: ML: compare the two likelihoods. Decide 1 if \(\dfrac{1}{\sigma_1}e^{-(y-1)^2/2\sigma_1^2}>\dfrac{1}{\sigma_0}e^{-y^2/2\sigma_0^2}\).
MME 是核心网的控制节点，只走信令（虚线）；HSS（用户数据库）、PCRF（策: The MME is the control node of the core network and carries only signalling (dashed); the HSS (subscriber database) and PCRF (policy and charging rules) are also in the EPC.
MMSE 不追求 ISI 为零，而是让\"残余 ISI + 放大后的噪声\"总和: MMSE does not aim for zero ISI; it minimises the sum "residual ISI + enhanced noise", so it beats ZF when the noise is large. How to get the error rate: first fix the values of the other symbols (so the ISI is deterministic), compute the conditional error rate, then average over all ISI combinations. All three Practice 6 questions use this method.
MMSE 和 DFE 就是为了解决这个问题；OFDM 也一样：深衰落子载波除以很: MMSE and DFE exist to solve this problem; the same holds for OFDM: dividing a deeply faded subcarrier by a very small H<sub>k</sub> enhances the noise, which is why water-filling gives it no power at all.
MMSE 线性均衡 vs 判决反馈均衡: MMSE linear equaliser vs decision-feedback equaliser
MMSE 线性均衡和 DFE 的误码率、DFE 的错误传播（p.26–34，Pr: Error rates of the MMSE linear equaliser and the DFE; error propagation in the DFE (p.26–34, Practice 6 Q3).
MPSK 的 M 个点均匀排在半径 \\(\\sqrt{E_s}\\) 的圆上，: The M points of MPSK are evenly spaced on a circle of radius \(\sqrt{E_s}\); adjacent points are 2π/M apart in angle, with chord length \(d_{\min}=2\sqrt{E_s}\sin(\pi/M)\). M = 2: \(2\sqrt{E_s}\); M = 4 (QPSK): \(1.414\sqrt{E_s}\); M = 8: \(0.765\sqrt{E_s}\). Into the bound: \(P_s\le(M-1)\,Q\big(\sqrt{2\gamma_s}\sin(\pi/M)\big)\). In practice each point has only 2 nearest neighbours, so the common approximation is \(2Q\big(\sqrt{2\gamma_s}\sin(\pi/M)\big)\). Doubling M again (8 → 16) roughly halves sin(π/M), so you need about 6 dB more SNR for the same error rate; this is what p.22 means by "more crowded points, more errors".

MRC 的权重是信道增益的共轭，相当于匹配滤波，输出 SNR 最大；EGC 只需: The MRC weights are the conjugates of the channel gains, equivalent to a matched filter, which maximises the output SNR; EGC only needs the phases, and the lecturer says in practice it performs about as well as MRC and is often good enough. He left the derivations of the MRC and EGC output SNR for you to practise after class.
MRC 输出 = 和；g = γ̄<sub>Σ</sub>/γ̄；d = −lo: MRC output = sum; g = γ̄<sub>Σ</sub>/γ̄; d = −log₁₀P̄/log₁₀γ̄ (use the input γ̄); if independent, E[e<sup>−(X+Y)</sup>] = E[e<sup>−X</sup>]E[e<sup>−Y</sup>].

RTS 和 CTS 里都写着接下来这次传输（数据 + ACK）要占用多长时间。周: Both RTS and CTS state how long the coming transmission (data + ACK) will take. Nearby nodes that hear them store this duration in a timer called the NAV (Network Allocation Vector) and do not transmit until it reaches zero. The key point (p.17): even if a node cannot hear the source's RTS, it can hear the destination's CTS, and still gives way.

RTS/CTS 就是\"先订座、再上菜\"：发送方先用短帧 RTS 订下信道，接: RTS/CTS works like "book the table, then serve the food": the sender books the channel with a short RTS frame, the receiver confirms with a CTS, and everyone nearby reads from these two frames how long the channel will be busy and stays out of the way. Two spacings are used: DIFS (long, the wait before normal contention) and SIFS (short, used between responses within the same exchange). Inside one exchange the gaps are only SIFS, while other stations must wait at least DIFS, so nobody can cut in halfway.

一句话：FDMA 分频率（AMPS），TDMA 分时隙（GSM、IS-136），: In one line: FDMA divides frequency (AMPS), TDMA divides time slots (GSM, IS-136), CDMA uses the same time and frequency and separates users by code (IS-95, WCDMA).
一句话：GBR 保证最低速率、永久占资源（VoIP），non-GBR 不保证（网: In one line: GBR guarantees a minimum rate and permanently holds resources (VoIP); non-GBR guarantees nothing (web browsing); the default bearer must be non-GBR.
一句话：GEO 35,863 km，MEO 8,000–18,000 km，LE: In one line: GEO 35,863 km, MEO 8,000–18,000 km, LEO 500–1,500 km, so A; 42,000 km is the orbital radius, do not confuse them.
一句话：GEO 在赤道上空，极地和高纬度仰角太低、覆盖差，所以 D 不是它的特点: In one line: GEO is above the equator; at the poles and high latitudes the elevation angle is too low and coverage is poor, so D is not one of its characteristics.
一句话：H(Z) 的系数就是抽头（h[1] = 1、h[3] = 0.6），C(: In one line: the coefficients of H(Z) are the taps (h[1] = 1, h[3] = 0.6); C(Z)H(Z) = 1 − 0.36Z⁻⁴ leaves residual ISI 0.36; the noise variance becomes 0.408; averaging the ±0.36 cases gives P<sub>b</sub> ≈ 0.087.
一句话：H<sub>k</sub> = 1 + 0.3e<sup>−jπk/2<: In one line: H<sub>k</sub> = 1 + 0.3e<sup>−jπk/2</sup> gives {1−0.3j, 0.7, 1+0.3j, 1.3}; sampling at t = iT/N is an IDFT; block length 8 + 20 = 28 µs, power loss 10 log₁₀3.5 ≈ 5.44 dB.
一句话：IoT 五大挑战：可扩展性、安全、隐私、大数据与分析、互操作性。: In one line: the five IoT challenges are scalability, security, privacy, big data and analysis, and interoperability.
一句话：IoT 五难是规模、安全、隐私、大数据、互通；雾计算把处理放到靠近终端的: In one line: the five IoT challenges are scalability, security, privacy, big data and interoperability; fog computing moves processing to fog nodes close to the endpoints, and its features are low latency/location awareness, geographic distribution, deployment near endpoints, wireless access and real-time interaction.
一句话：L 是抽头数 2；ISI ±0.3 分两种情况求 Q 再平均得 0.06: In one line: L is the number of taps, 2; split the ISI ±0.3 into two cases, find Q for each and average to get 0.068; after the equalizer the noise variance is multiplied by (1 + c₁² + c₂²), so it always grows.
一句话：LEO 每次过顶约 15–20 分钟（MEO 2–8 小时，GEO 永久: In one line: each LEO pass lasts about 15–20 minutes (MEO 2–8 hours, GEO permanent), so A.
一句话：LEO 近所以信号强、省频谱、适合手持，但多普勒大、有大气阻力、要很多卫: In one line: LEO is close, so the signal is strong, it saves spectrum and suits handhelds; but the Doppler shift is large, there is atmospheric drag, and it needs many satellites and frequent handovers. Little LEO is below 1 GHz with up to 10 kbps; Big LEO is above 1 GHz with up to a few Mbps and adds voice and positioning.
一句话：MANET 是无基础设施、自组织的临时网络；和 WLAN 最大的区别是每: In one line: a MANET is a temporary, self-organising network without infrastructure; its main difference from a WLAN is that every node must act as a router and forward over multiple hops.
一句话：MEO 比 LEO 切换少得多，但时延和所需功率更大，选 B。: In one line: MEO has far fewer handovers than LEO, but larger delay and required power, so B.
一句话：N = 7、n = 4 时，2+2+2 分组得 17.27 dB，全按: In one line: for N = 7, n = 4, the 2+2+2 grouping gives 17.27 dB and all-at-D − R gives 14.39 dB, both lower than the 18.66 dB of the simplified method.
一句话：Nyquist 准则是脉冲在别人的采样点上为零；噪声功率 0.25 ×: In one line: the Nyquist criterion means the pulse is zero at the other symbols' sampling points; noise power 0.25 × 2.56 = 0.64; σ′ = 0.8, and averaging the two ISI cases ±0.2 gives P<sub>e</sub> ≈ 0.113.
一句话：RB = 12 子载波 × 7 符号 = 84 个 RE（扩展 CP 为: In one line: RB = 12 subcarriers × 7 symbols = 84 REs (72 with extended CP).
一句话：S/I = Q<sup>n</sup>/6、Q² = 3N、n = 4: In one line: S/I = Q<sup>n</sup>/6, Q² = 3N, n = 4 → 1.5N² → 1.76 + 20 log N; N = 7 gives 18.66 dB; 20 dB needs n ≈ 4.2; worst-case omni 18.5 dB, 120° sectors 25.9 dB.
一句话：SNR 只取几个离散值，先算单支路，再算两路 MRC（独立 / 共享阴影: In one line: the SNR takes only a few discrete values; first do one branch, then two-branch MRC (independent / shared shadowing), and compare average SNR, error rate, array gain and diversity gain.
一句话：TDMA 的保护时间和控制比特比 FDMA 的保护带占用更少容量，选 B: In one line: TDMA's guard times and control bits take less capacity than FDMA's guard bands, so B.
一句话：UFCA 每小区 = 总数 ÷ N = 210 ÷ 7 = 30 条，留: In one line: under UFCA, per cell = total ÷ N = 210 ÷ 7 = 30 channels; keep 1 for control, leaving 29 for calls.
一句话：VSAT 天线 0.3–0.9 m（小型 1–10 m，大型 10–60: In one line: VSAT antennas are 0.3–0.9 m (small stations 1–10 m, large stations 10–60 m), so C.
一句话：WLAN 四类应用：LAN 扩展、楼间互联、游牧接入、自组网，每类配一个: In one line: the four WLAN applications are LAN extension, cross-building interconnect, nomadic access and ad hoc networking, each with an example (p.7–8).
一句话：WSN 节点多几个数量级、密集易坏拓扑常变、用广播、功率计算内存都受限。: In one line: WSNs have orders of magnitude more nodes, are dense and failure-prone with frequently changing topology, use broadcast, and are limited in power, computing and memory.
一句话：d<sub>max</sub> = 5 × 3 = 15；SNR = (: In one line: d<sub>max</sub> = 5 × 3 = 15; SNR = (10⁻³)<sup>−1/3</sup> = 10, R = 2 log₂10 ≈ 6.64 bit/s/Hz; uninformed transmitter P = (P/N)I, with a single antenna C/B = log₂(1 + 16) ≈ 4.09 bit/s/Hz.
一句话：n = 4 时 S/I = (3N)²/6；10 dB 要求的最小 N: In one line: for n = 4, S/I = (3N)²/6; the smallest N for the 10 dB requirement is 3, and the optimum N for 18 dB voice quality is 7.
一句话：y 是\"以 ±1 为中心、方差 0.25 的高斯\"，门限在 0，离门: In one line: y is "Gaussian centred at ±1 with variance 0.25"; the threshold is at 0 and the distance to it is 1 = 2σ, so the error probability is Q(2) ≈ 0.023.
一句话：一发两收、独立衰落、合并后同时深衰落的概率很小，就是 SIMO 分集；对: In one line: one transmit and two receive antennas, independent fading, and a small chance that both fade at once after combining: that is SIMO diversity. The determinant of a diagonal matrix is a product, and the log turns it into a sum: that is MIMO = r parallel channels.
一句话：三层 = 物、通信网络、应用与分析；通信网络层四子层 = 接入网、网关与: In one line: three layers = things, communications network, application and analytics; the four sublayers of the communications network layer = access network, gateways and backhaul, network transport, IoT network management.
一句话：三径信道：(a) 求时延均值和 rms 扩展，(b) 求多普勒和相干时间: In one line: three-path channel: (a) mean delay and rms spread, (b) Doppler and coherence time, then classify the fading, (c) average fade duration for a threshold 10 dB down and the number of symbols affected.
一句话：上行 + 下行共 71,726 km，除以 3×10⁵ km/s，约 0: In one line: uplink + downlink total 71,726 km; divided by 3×10⁵ km/s, this is about 0.239 s.
一句话：两个基站、阴影独立：(a) 单基站 Q(10/8)，(b) 两个相乘，(: In one line: two base stations, independent shadowing: (a) one base station, Q(10/8), (b) multiply the two, (c) inverse Q lookup for the margin one base station would need; the difference is the macrodiversity gain.
一句话：两个用户同时发，(a) 先解用户 1、把用户 2 当噪声，(b) 减掉用: In one line: two users transmit together; (a) decode user 1 treating user 2 as noise, (b) subtract user 1 and then decode user 2; use the Shannon formula for each capacity.
一句话：两帧 = DATA + ACK；四帧 = RTS + CTS + DAT: In one line: two-frame = DATA + ACK; four-frame = RTS + CTS + DATA + ACK, where the CTS makes hidden nodes that cannot hear the sender also set their NAV and back off.
一句话：两径信道上的 OFDM：说明 N 怎么选，算出 4 个子载波的增益，再分: In one line: OFDM over a two-path channel: explain how to choose N, compute the gains of the 4 subcarriers, then allocate power by "equal capacity" and by "water-filling".
一句话：两状态信道：(a) 用全概率求平均误码率，(b) 用贝叶斯求\"出错时处: In one line: two-state channel: (a) average error probability by total probability, (b) probability of the bad state given an error by Bayes' rule, (c) mean and variance of the SNR (convert to linear first).
一句话：仰角 0° 时视线垂直于半径，cos β = 6370/42233 =: In one line: at 0° elevation the line of sight is perpendicular to the radius, cos β = 6370/42233 = 0.1508, β ≈ 81.3°, coverage diameter about 18,000 km.
一句话：仰角在地面站量（切线到卫星方向），覆盖角在地心量（最小仰角下可见的地表）: In one line: the elevation angle is measured at the earth station (from the tangent to the satellite direction); the coverage angle is measured at the earth's centre (the surface visible at the minimum elevation angle); the ideal minimum elevation angle is 0°, giving coverage to the optical horizon.
一句话：仰角越低，信号穿过的大气越厚，雨衰和雾衰都明显增大，选 B。: In one line: the lower the elevation angle, the thicker the atmosphere the signal crosses, and both rain and fog attenuation increase markedly, so B.
一句话：传感器节点采集数据，多跳、无基础设施地接力转发到 sink，sink 再: In one line: sensor nodes collect data and relay it multi-hop, without infrastructure, to the sink; the sink sends it via the Internet or satellite to the task manager node, where the manager gets the data and issues tasks.
一句话：信道数 = 基站数 × 60；半径减半，基站数约 × 4，所以 240: In one line: channels = base stations × 60; halving the radius multiplies base stations by about 4, so 240 channels become about 900.
一句话：信道有一个强度 α 的回声，比较不均衡和用 1 − αz⁻¹ 均衡时的误: In one line: the channel has an echo of strength α; compare the error rate without equalisation and with the 1 − αz⁻¹ equaliser, and see which is better at high SNR.
一句话：信道有一个晚 1 个采样的回波，问 OFDM 的循环前缀至少多长才能挡住: In one line: the channel has an echo 1 sample late; the question asks how long the OFDM cyclic prefix must be at least to block the ISI, and why.
一句话：倒查 Q 表得 γ<sub>b</sub> = 4.5 → 单支路中断: In one line: reverse Q-table lookup gives γ<sub>b</sub> = 4.5 → single-branch outage 0.139 → 0.139<sup>M</sup> = 0.02 → M ≈ 1.98; take M = 2 and verify 0.0194.
一句话：先在标准线上读出 −81.70 dBm，再加五项修正（功率比、基站高度两: In one line: read −81.70 dBm off the standard line, then add five corrections (power ratio, two BS-height terms, MS height, gain difference) to get −84.22 dBm.
一句话：先换线性值，列出两路组合的概率（差情况只剩 0.2² = 0.04），每: In one line: convert to linear first, list the probabilities of the two-branch combinations (the bad case is left with only 0.2² = 0.04), compute ½e<sup>−γ</sup> for each case and weight them: average SNR 11.67 dB, SD symbol error rate ≈ 9.71×10⁻⁷.
一句话：先换线性再平均得 16.43（12.2 dB），MRC 相加得 32.8: In one line: convert to linear first, then average to get 16.43 (12.2 dB); MRC adds to give 32.86 (15.2 dB); d computed with the input SNR is about 3.0.
一句话：全送云端会遇到带宽小、时延大、回程不可靠、数据太多；雾计算在边缘附近处理: In one line: sending everything to the cloud runs into little bandwidth, long latency, unreliable backhaul and too much data; fog computing processes data near the edge, cutting latency and traffic and keeping data local.
一句话：减控制 → 对半分 → 除 25 kHz → 一对单工 = 一个双工 →: In one line: remove control → halve → divide by 25 kHz → one pair of simplex = one duplex → divide by 7, giving 560 for the system and 80 per cell.
一句话：功率在 dB 上服从高斯，(a) 求低于 10 dBm 的概率，(b): In one line: the power in dB is Gaussian; (a) find the probability of being below 10 dBm, (b) in reverse, find how high the mean must be for this probability to be < 1%.
一句话：参考突发 + 各站数据突发（中间隔保护时间）；每个突发 = 前导（定时恢: In one line: reference burst + station data bursts (separated by guard times); each burst = preamble (timing recovery, unique word, station identification, network control and request) + information.
一句话：发送方 DIFS → RTS，接收方 SIFS → CTS，发送方 SI: In one line: sender DIFS → RTS, receiver SIFS → CTS, sender SIFS → data, receiver SIFS → ACK; bystanders set NAV, wait NAV + DIFS, then back off.
一句话：取 dB 后是一条直线（斜率 γ、截距 −K<sub>dB</sub>）: In one line: in dB it is a straight line (slope γ, intercept −K<sub>dB</sub>); outage = Q(margin/σ), σ² < 18.5 dB²; answer both dimensions of the fading type (flat + slow); the fade margin depends only on ε, 0.1% → 30 dB.
一句话：同一个 ISI 信道，(a) 求 MMSE 线性均衡器的最优 q 和误码: In one line: for the same ISI channel, (a) find the optimal q and error rate of the MMSE linear equaliser, (b) find the long-run error rate of the DFE with error propagation, and compare the two.
一句话：同一场景依次用路径损耗、阴影（Q）、瑞利（指数）、莱斯（K）、σ/T_s: In one line: in one scenario, answer six parts using path loss, shadowing (Q), Rayleigh (exponential), Rician (K), σ/T_s and T_C in turn, to practise "identify the effect first, then choose the formula".
一句话：同样 1% 阻塞，10 条合用承载 4.46 Er（44.6%），拆成: In one line: at the same 1% blocking, 10 pooled channels carry 4.46 Er (44.6%), while 5 + 5 carry only 2.72 Er (27.2%); pooling carries about 60% more, at the cost of a worse SIR than split groups.
一句话：子载波带宽 250 kHz → N = 4；H<sub>k</sub>: In one line: subcarrier bandwidth 250 kHz → N = 4; H<sub>k</sub> is the 4-point DFT of h = {0.8+0.6j, 1.8, 0.8−0.6j, 0.6}; block length 4 + 1 = 5 µs; power loss 10 log₁₀(5/4) ≈ 0.97 dB.
一句话：子载波带宽小于相干带宽 → N ≥ 17；N = 50 时块长 100: In one line: subcarrier bandwidth below the coherence bandwidth → N ≥ 17; with N = 50 the block is 100 + 10 µs and carries 100 bit, effective rate about 909 kbit/s; the subcarriers are orthogonal, so the correlator keeps only s<sub>n</sub>.
一句话：带宽 → 信道 → 扣控制 → 分小区 → 查表得 A → A ÷ (B: In one line: bandwidth → channels → remove control → share among cells → table gives A → A ÷ (B<sub>w</sub> × A<sub>c</sub>) is η<sub>m</sub>, A ÷ h is the number of calls, and ÷ 1.2 gives the number of users.
一句话：平坦衰落每对天线一个复增益，y = Hx + v，H 是 6×4；Ala: In one line: under flat fading each antenna pair has one complex gain, y = Hx + v, H is 6×4; the Alamouti decision statistic has mean s (unbiased) and variance σ²/‖h‖² (square the coefficient, then multiply by the noise variance).
一句话：形状分圆（圆心在地心）和椭圆（一个焦点在地心）；倾角分赤道、极轨道和倾斜: In one line: by shape, circular (centre at the earth's centre) and elliptical (one focus at the earth's centre); by inclination, equatorial, polar and inclined.
一句话：手机同时连两个基站，两个都低于门限才算断线。(b) 算两边阴影独立时的断: In one line: the phone connects to two base stations at once and drops only if both are below the threshold. (b) finds the drop probability with independent shadowing, (c) with shared shadowing, showing that correlation reduces the benefit of "one more base station".
一句话：扫描（被动等 Beacon / 主动发 Probe）→ 认证（双方证明知: In one line: scanning (passive: wait for Beacon / active: send Probe) → authentication (both sides prove they know the password; blocks illegal access) → association (exchange capabilities, register location with the DS) → only then send and receive data.
一句话：把\"幅度 + 相位调制的余弦\"拆成 cos 和 sin 两个方向，找: In one line: split the "amplitude + phase modulated cosine" into a cos and a sin direction, find these two normalised axes, and the dimension is 2.
一句话：把均匀的功率时延分布当成概率分布，求时延的均值和标准差，再用 σ/T_s: In one line: treat the uniform power delay profile as a probability distribution, find the mean and standard deviation of the delay, then use σ/T_s < 0.1 to find the maximum symbol rate allowed for flat fading.
一句话：拓扑变化慢到所有更新都能传播完就叫组合稳定，取决于连通性、路由协议复杂度: In one line: if the topology changes slowly enough for all updates to propagate, the network is combinatorially stable; this depends on connectivity, routing protocol complexity and node computing power.
一句话：接入网（最后一公里无线：802.11ah、802.15.4g、LoRa）: In one line: access network (last-mile wireless: 802.11ah, 802.15.4g, LoRa) → gateways and backhaul (area aggregation, long-range link back to the centre) → network transport (IP, UDP/TCP) → network management (HTTP, WebSocket).
一句话：数据库存用户签约信息和位置，供 MSC 接续、寻呼、鉴权和漫游查询；HL: In one line: the databases store user subscription data and location for the MSC to connect calls, page, authenticate and handle roaming; the HLR is the permanent, central "home registration", the VLR is each service area's temporary "visitor registration".
一句话：无衰落时 h = 0，快衰落时 h 快速时变要跟踪；迫零取 1/(1 +: In one line: with no fading h = 0; with fast fading h changes quickly and must be tracked; ZF takes the first three terms of 1/(1 + 0.2Z⁻¹): 1, −0.2, 0.04; with residual ISI 0.6, average over the two cases ±0.6 to get P<sub>e</sub> ≈ 0.166.
一句话：星内（同一卫星换波束）、星间（换卫星，用户动或卫星飞走）、网关（卫星离开: In one line: intra-satellite (same satellite, new beam), inter-satellite (new satellite; the user moves or the satellite moves away), gateway (the satellite leaves the current gateway), inter-system (vertical handover between satellite and terrestrial cellular).
一句话：有回声的二进制信道，比较\"直接判正负\"和\"先迫零消回声再判\"的误: In one line: a binary channel with an echo; compare the error rate of "decide on the sign directly" with "zero-force the echo first, then decide"; the latter has no ISI but the noise is amplified.
一句话：有星间链路时 1 上 1 下，还能少建网关；没有时 2 上 2 下，选: In one line: with inter-satellite links, 1 up and 1 down, and fewer gateways are needed; without them, 2 up and 2 down, so A.
一句话：核心功能栈 = Things / 通信网络（接入、网关回传、传输、管理四: In one line: core functional stack = Things / communications network (four sublayers: access, gateway-backhaul, transport, management) / applications and analytics; compute stack = edge / fog / cloud; fog computing solves four problems: bandwidth, latency, unreliable backhaul and excessive data volume.
一句话：每小区 1071/7 = 153 条，簇面积 42 km²，复制 210: In one line: 1071/7 = 153 channels per cell, cluster area 42 km², 2100/42 = 50 replications, system capacity 1071 × 50 = 53 550 channels.
一句话：每小时呼叫数 = A × 30；不分扇区 1326，120° 只剩 10: In one line: calls per hour = A × 30; no sectoring 1326, 120° only 1008 (−24%), 60° about 44% lower: SIR goes up, trunking efficiency goes down.
一句话：每种模式是一个排列，全连通需要 N! 种，5! = 120。: In one line: each mode is a permutation; full connectivity needs N! modes, and 5! = 120.
一句话：比较 SNR、SIR、SINR 并求香农容量，看消掉干扰后容量提升多少，: In one line: compare SNR, SIR and SINR and find the Shannon capacity, see how much the capacity rises when the interference is cancelled, then find the capacity of a Rayleigh channel at 1% outage and compare it with AWGN.
一句话：求 AWGN 信道的 SNR 和香农容量，看带宽加倍后容量是否翻倍，再用: In one line: find the SNR and Shannon capacity of an AWGN channel, check whether doubling the bandwidth doubles the capacity, then split power over two subchannels by water-filling.
一句话：波束变 → 星内；卫星变 → 星间；网关变 → 网关；系统变 → 系统间: In one line: beam changes → intra-satellite; satellite changes → inter-satellite; gateway changes → gateway; system changes → inter-system (vertical handover).
一句话：点对点（两站）、广播（一发多收）、双向星形（hub 加许多 VSAT，远: In one line: point-to-point (two stations), broadcast (one transmits, many receive), two-way star (a hub plus many VSATs, with remote stations relayed through the hub).
一句话：瑞利衰落时信号会掉进深坑，题目问\"低于 rms 值 0.1 倍\"的坑: In one line: under Rayleigh fading the signal falls into deep holes; the question asks how long, on average, a hole "below 0.1 of the rms value" lasts. Find ρ and substitute into the formula.
一句话：瑞利衰落：求 SNR 低于 7 dB 的概率，反推中断 1% 所需的平均: In one line: Rayleigh fading: find the probability that the SNR is below 7 dB, invert to get the average SNR and fade margin for 1% outage, then find the probability that the SNR is above its average.
一句话：用 6 个测量点拟合一条 dB 直线得到 K、γ，再把点偏离直线的程度当: In one line: fit a dB line to the 6 measured points to get K and γ, then treat the deviation of the points from the line as the shadowing σ, and find the probability of being "more than 10 dB below the average".
一句话：用 B_C、B_D、B_s 判断平坦慢衰落；由观测次数求 LCR、时间比: In one line: use B_C, B_D and B_s to classify the fading as flat and slow; from the observed count find the LCR, the time fraction and the errors per second; then use 1 − e^(−ρ²) to find how many dB down the threshold is.
一句话：用自由空间公式算 1 km 的接收功率，看距离和频率加倍各少几 dB，再: In one line: use the free-space formula for the received power at 1 km, find how many dB doubling the distance and doubling the frequency each cost, then compare with the simplified model at γ = 3.5 to show why the two must not be mixed up.

Each lane is narrow enough to be "smooth" (flat fading), and each cart is slow enough that "the echo of a bump cannot reach the next trip" (no ISI).

三层是<b>叠加</b>的：接收功率(dB) = 发射功率 − 路径损耗（平均值: The three layers add up: received power (dB) = transmit power − path loss (average) + shadowing fluctuation (Gaussian, a few dB) + multipath fluctuation (Rayleigh, can go as deep as −20 or −30 dB). 三种算法是同一个系统，只是对\"干扰离多远\"的假设一个比一个悲观，算出来的 S: All three methods describe the same system; each makes a more pessimistic assumption about "how far away the interferers are", so each gives a lower SIR. 信号在路上要穿过 M 个障碍物，每个都把功率乘上一个衰减因子 \\(A_i\\): On its way the signal passes M obstacles, and each one multiplies the power by an attenuation factor \(A_i\), so the total attenuation is \(\psi=\prod A_i\) (p.11). Taking logs turns the product into a sum: \(\log\psi=\sum\log A_i\). A sum of many random terms is approximately Gaussian by the central limit theorem, so ψ in dB is Gaussian, and ψ itself is called log-normal. Typical values from the slides: mean 0, variance 4 < σ² < 12 (in dB², p.11). Note that the slide gives the variance, which matches the course examples (σ² is the fitted MSE, e.g. 11.87 dB²); some textbooks (e.g. Goldsmith) give the standard deviation σ as about 4–13 dB — do not mix them up.

信道是 AWGN 信道（Additive White Gaussian Nois: The channel is an AWGN channel (Additive White Gaussian Noise): the noise is simply added to the signal (additive), has the same power at all frequencies and is uncorrelated between time instants (white), and its amplitude is Gaussian with zero mean; there is no other impairment (no fading, no multipath). 信道有多径时，一个符号的能量会\"拖尾\"到后面几个采样时刻，造成符号间干扰（I: With multipath, a symbol's energy "smears" into the next few sampling instants, causing inter-symbol interference (ISI). Sampled at the symbol interval, the channel is a set of tap coefficients h[1], h[2], …, h[L], and the received signal is the convolution of the message sequence with the taps plus noise (Ch. 6 p.22): r[n] = Σh[i]m[n − i + 1] + w(n). 卫星绕地球转得多快由高度决定：越高越慢。开普勒第三定律给出周期 T = 2π√(: How fast a satellite circles the Earth is set by its altitude: the higher, the slower. Kepler's third law gives the period T = 2π√(a³/μ) (a is the orbit radius = Earth radius + altitude, μ = 398,600 km³/s²). For the period to equal exactly one rotation of the Earth (about 24 hours), a can only be about 42,233 km; subtract the Earth radius 6,370 km and you get 35,863 km. So the "stationary" orbit has only one altitude, and it must be above the equator, otherwise the satellite swings north and south.

因为 e<sup>j2πkt/T</sup> 以 T 为周期，前面多出的 T<s: Because e<sup>j2πkt/T</sup> is periodic with period T, the extra T<sub>g</sub> segment at the front is an exact copy of the last T<sub>g</sub> of the block: this is what makes it a "cyclic" prefix. The receiver discards this segment and keeps only nT ≤ t < (n+1)T. (If you count time in block periods of T + T<sub>g</sub>, you can also write the interval as n(T+T<sub>g</sub>) ≤ t < (n+1)(T+T<sub>g</sub>) and use t − n(T+T<sub>g</sub>) − T<sub>g</sub> in the exponent.)

均衡器 C(Z) 是一个 FIR 滤波器，它不仅作用在信号上，也作用在噪声上（p: The equalizer C(Z) is an FIR filter; it acts on the noise as well as on the signal (p.21, p.25): w′(n) = Σc<sub>j</sub>w(n − j). The w samples are independent, each with variance σ²; the variance of a sum of independent variables is the sum of their variances, with the coefficients squared: σ′² = σ²Σc<sub>j</sub>². With a main tap of 1, Σc<sub>j</sub>² is greater than 1 as soon as any other tap is non-zero. This is "noise enhancement" (p.41). The lecturer said that for the equalization chapter you must be able to do three things: write the channel and the equalizer as Z-transforms, find the ZF coefficients (long division), and compute the noise power.

The noise samples are independent with the same variance σ², so the output noise power is σ′² = σ²Σc<sub>j</sub>² (the "variance σ²‖c‖²" on p.27). It borrows techniques from wireless ad hoc networks but has its own features (Part B p.56): the number of nodes is several orders of magnitude larger than in an ad hoc network; nodes are densely deployed and prone to failure, so the topology changes often; nodes communicate by broadcast, whereas ad hoc networks are point-to-point; and nodes have very limited power, computing capacity and memory. These features dictate how it communicates: no infrastructure, multi-hop forwarding.

It is built with ad hoc network techniques, but existing ad hoc protocols are not necessarily suitable, because of four differences (p.56).

Their only goal was to get voice calls through; there was no real spectral-efficiency optimisation, let alone data services.

最时间敏感的数据在边缘或最近的雾节点处理；可以等几秒到几分钟的送到汇聚节点；不敏: The most time-sensitive data is processed at the edge or the nearest fog node; data that can wait seconds to minutes goes to an aggregation node; non-sensitive data goes to the cloud for historical analysis and long-term storage (p.113). Edge (mist) computing pushes fog all the way into the end devices themselves (p.110).

The advantage is simplicity: the objects only need to connect to one central application, which can see every node and do all the analysis (p.103). But IoT data volumes are huge, so bandwidth management becomes a problem: the network must carry the traffic, and the servers must take in, store and process the data (p.104).

The \((P_r/P_t)_{dB}\) in the table is this ratio (negative = loss).
有人提议加一个均衡器 U(z) = 1 − αz⁻¹，想抵消回声。但均衡器不只作: Someone proposes adding an equaliser U(z) = 1 − αz⁻¹ to cancel the echo. But the equaliser acts not only on the signal, it also acts on the noise.
有分组要发 → 侦听信道。: A packet is ready to send → sense the channel.
有分组要发 → 先侦听信道。下面分两种情况。: Packet to send → sense the channel first. There are two cases below.
有基础设施的网络：每个包都要先交给 AP（或基站）再转出去，AP 是中心。: Infrastructure network: every packet is first handed to the AP (or base station) and then forwarded; the AP is the centre.
有干扰时分母要写 I + N。Practice 2 Q3 (a) 写成 10/0: With interference, the denominator must be I + N. Writing 10/0.1 = 100 in Practice 2 Q3 (a) pretends user 2 does not exist; only after MUD subtracts the other user does the user decoded later have just N in the denominator.
有干扰时香农公式里用 SINR，不是 SNR。: With interference, use the SINR in Shannon's formula, not the SNR.
有数据要发才做路由发现，通信期间维护: Route discovery only when there is data to send; maintained during communication
有数据要发时才做路由发现，通信期间维护: Route discovery only when there is data to send; route maintained during the communication
有星间链路：信息在太空中直接转发，只要 1 上 1 下，还能减少地面网关。没有星: With an inter-satellite link: information is forwarded directly in space, so only 1 up and 1 down are needed, and fewer ground gateways. Without an inter-satellite link: the satellite first sends down to a gateway, the terrestrial network carries it to the other satellite's gateway, which sends it up; that takes 2 up and 2 down (p.39).

有用部分是 NT<sub>s</sub> = 8 µs，不是 2 µs；CP 比: The useful part is NT<sub>s</sub> = 8 µs, not 2 µs; the CP is longer than the data, so the loss is as high as 5.44 dB.
有线 LAN 速度快、稳定，但要拉线：大空间布线贵，两栋楼之间不好挖沟，人走动时: A wired LAN is fast and stable, but needs cables: wiring a large space is expensive, digging trenches between two buildings is hard, and people on the move cannot carry a network cable. The four WLAN applications (notes Part B p.7–8) match exactly these four "cabling is awkward" situations. Memorise them in order of distance from near to far and from fixed to mobile: extension → cross-building → nomadic → ad hoc.

核心 IoT 功能栈有三层：Things 层 → <b>通信网络层</b> →: The core IoT functional stack has three layers: Things layer → communications network layer → application and analytics layer (notes Part B p.88–90). If smart objects are not self-contained, they must report the information they collect, exchange it with other objects or be controlled by a management platform; all of this relies on the communications network layer. From bottom to top it has four sublayers (p.89–99), which you can think of as "four gates the data passes through on its way from the sensor to the application".

The access network E-UTRAN has essentially only one kind of node: the eNodeB, which connects to the UE by radio. The interfaces between network elements are all standardised, so equipment from different vendors interoperates.

每一路先乘上自己增益的共轭：<b>相位对齐</b>（\\(e^{-j\\thet: Each branch is first multiplied by the conjugate of its own gain: phase alignment (\(e^{-j\theta_i}\)) and weighting by signal strength (\(A_i\): stronger branches count more). The result: the output SNR equals the sum of the branch SNRs, the best any linear combiner can do. Cost: every branch needs channel estimation (p.17).

每一项 B log₂(1 + λ<sub>i</sub>/σ²) 正是一条 SN: Each term B log₂(1 + λ<sub>i</sub>/σ²) is exactly the Shannon capacity of a single-input single-output channel with SNR λ<sub>i</sub>/σ².
每一项正是一个 SNR 为 λ<sub>i</sub>/σ² 的 SISO 信道: Each term is exactly the Shannon capacity of a SISO channel with SNR λ<sub>i</sub>/σ². So the MIMO channel (after SVD) is equivalent to K = rank(H) ≤ min(N, M) non-interfering parallel sub-channels, and the total capacity is their sum. This is also why MIMO capacity grows linearly with min(N, M).
每个 BSS 有一个 AP：相当于网桥，负责 BSS 和外界的连接，并提供中心协: Each BSS has an AP: it acts as a bridge, connects the BSS to the outside and provides central coordination.

每个坐标上的噪声独立、均值 0、方差 \\(N_0/2\\)。这 D 个数是<b: The noise on each coordinate is independent, zero-mean, with variance \(N_0/2\). These D numbers are sufficient statistics: all the information needed to decide which symbol was sent is in them, so looking only at these numbers costs no performance.
每个块传 50 个 4-QAM 符号，每个符号 log₂4 = 2 bit，共: Each block carries 50 4-QAM symbols of log₂4 = 2 bit each, 100 bit in total:
每个基站 60 条信道\"regardless of cell size\"，微: Each base station has 60 channels "regardless of cell size", so a microcell also has 60.

每个基站都连到 MTSO（移动交换中心），老师说它是整个蜂窝系统的\"大脑\"。: Every base station connects to the MTSO (mobile switching centre); the lecturer calls it the "brain" of the whole cellular system.
每个子信道只剩一个复数增益，这正是 OFDM 把频率选择性信道变成 N 个平坦子: Each subchannel is left with a single complex gain. This is exactly how OFDM turns a frequency-selective channel into N flat subchannels.
每个子帧分 2 个时隙，每个 0.5 ms，所以一帧有 10 × 2 = 20: Each subframe has 2 slots of 0.5 ms each, so a frame has 10 × 2 = 20 slots.
每个子载波一抽头均衡，容量逐个相加: One-tap equaliser per subcarrier; capacities add up
每个子载波占 B/N 的带宽，所以按 bit/s/Hz 算要除以 N = 4：C: Each subcarrier occupies B/N of the bandwidth, so in bit/s/Hz divide by N = 4: C ≈ 1.79 ≈ 1.8 bit/s/Hz
每个子载波只要除以一个复数（估计出的信道增益），比第 6 章的时域均衡器简单得多: Each subcarrier only needs to be divided by one complex number (the estimated channel gain), which is far simpler than the time-domain equalisers of Ch. 6. This is the basic reason OFDM can reach high rates (p.27): it turns a frequency-selective channel into N parallel flat channels, with no need for complex time-domain equalisation.
每个子载波都要 ¼ log₂(1 + P<sub>k</sub>|H<sub>k: Each subcarrier needs ¼ log₂(1 + P<sub>k</sub>|H<sub>k</sub>|²) = 0.9. First multiply by 4:

每个帧带一个\"持续时间\"字段，附近节点据此设置 NAV；NAV 不为零就认为: Every frame carries a "duration" field, and nearby nodes set their NAV from it. While the NAV is non-zero the channel is treated as busy; this is virtual carrier sensing (p.23).

每个数字是一组信道。粗线框里是一个簇：N 个小区刚好把全部信道用完一遍。: Each number is a channel set. The thick outline is one cluster: N cells use all the channels exactly once.
每个时隙里，常规循环前缀有 <b>7</b> 个 OFDM 符号，扩展循环前缀有: Each slot has 7 OFDM symbols with the normal cyclic prefix and 6 with the extended cyclic prefix. The extended CP is used in large cells (long delay spread). The number of subcarriers in frequency depends on the system bandwidth.

直射路径长 l，地面反射路径长 l′。d 远大于天线高度时，两条路程差 \\(\: The direct path has length l and the ground-reflected path l′. When d is much larger than the antenna heights, the path difference is \(\Delta l=l'-l\approx\dfrac{2h_th_r}{d}\).

直观看：子载波 2 上，直射和延迟两路正好反相相减，只剩 0.2；子载波 0（=: Intuitively: on subcarrier 2, the direct and delayed paths are exactly out of phase and subtract, leaving only 0.2; on subcarrier 0 (= 4) they add in phase, giving 1.4.
直觉：5 µs 里只有 4 µs 有用，20% 的时间和能量花在保护间隔上，速率: Intuition: only 4 µs of every 5 µs is useful; 20% of the time and energy is spent on the guard interval, and the rate drops to 4/5 of the original.
直觉：只要 h₁、h₂ 不同时很小，SNR 就不会太差。两者独立时，同时很小的概: Intuition: as long as h₁ and h₂ are not both small, the SNR will not be too bad. When they are independent, the probability that both are small is far lower than the probability that one of them is small (p.15).
相乘再积分：正（绿）负（红）面积正好抵消，(1/T)∫₀<sup>T</sup>: Multiply and integrate: the positive (green) and negative (red) areas cancel exactly, (1/T)∫₀<sup>T</sup> = 0. This is orthogonality.
相乘：\\(P_r=\\dfrac{P_tG_t}{4\\pi d^2}\\cd: Multiply: \(P_r=\dfrac{P_tG_t}{4\pi d^2}\cdot\dfrac{G_r\lambda^2}{4\pi}=P_t\dfrac{G_tG_r\lambda^2}{(4\pi d)^2}\). So \(P_r\propto d^{-2}\) (γ = 2), and \(\lambda=c/f\) gives \(P_r\propto f^{-2}\).
Correlation weakens macro-diversity. Take Δ = σ: one base station gives 15.9% outage; two independent base stations 2.5%; with correlation ρ = 0.5, 6.3%; fully correlated, back to 15.9%, as if there were no second base station. The gain of macro-diversity comes from "if one fails, the other still works"; if the two often fail together, the backup does not help.

线性 MMSE 要最小化 \\(E\\big[(s-\\sum_ic_ir_i): Linear MMSE minimises \(E\big[(s-\sum_ic_ir_i)^2\big]\) (p.26). Differentiate with respect to each \(c_j\) and set it to 0: \(-2E\big[(s-\sum_ic_ir_i)\,r_j\big]=0\), i.e. the estimation error is uncorrelated with every observation (orthogonality principle). This gives a set of linear equations \(\sum_ic_iE[r_ir_j]=E[sr_j]\). Practice 6 Q3 has only one unknown coefficient q: the error is \(u_n-A_n=\tfrac q2A_n+\tfrac12A_{n-1}+qA_{n+1}+z_n+qz_{n+1}\), the observation is \(y_{n+1}=A_{n+1}+\tfrac12A_n+z_{n+1}\), and the expectation of their product \(=\tfrac q4+q+q=2.25q\). Setting it to 0 gives q = 0, the same as differentiating 1.25 + 2.25q² directly. When the noise is very small, MMSE approaches ZF; when the noise is large, MMSE removes a little less ISI and enhances the noise a little less.

翻开任何一本讲蜂窝网络的书，配图几乎永远是一堆整整齐齐的六边形拼接图案，很多人第: Open any book on cellular networks and the figures almost always show neat tiled hexagons. Many people's first reaction is "this is just a sketch; real coverage must be circular". That intuition is right: the radiation pattern of a single base-station antenna is indeed close to a circle in theory. But engineers draw hexagons because hexagons have a property circles lack: they tile the whole plane with no gaps and no overlaps, each hexagon shares a full edge with each neighbour, and the spacing between antennas is the same everywhere. If you tile a plane with circles, there must be gaps between them or they must overlap, and both cause trouble (gaps mean dead zones, overlaps mean waste). Triangles and squares also tile the plane, but the hexagon is the best compromise between two requirements: "more sides, closer to a circle, so closer to real antenna coverage" and "tiles regularly".

Method: first fix the ISI value and find the conditional error probability Q((q₀ + ISI)/σ); then average over all possible ISI values. It is the same idea as in Ch. 3, with one extra layer of averaging.

讲义 p.3 列了四类模型：自由空间（太简单）、射线追踪（需要现场几何数据）、经: p.3 of the notes lists four kinds of model: free space (too simple), ray tracing (needs site geometry data), empirical models (Okumura, Hata, COST 231; inaccurate in a different environment), and the simplified path loss model (best for analysis; the main one used in the exam).
讲义 p.31–32：B<sub>s</sub> &lt; B<sub>C</s: Notes p.31–32: Bs < BC flat, Bs > BC frequency-selective; the lecturer's simple version: if the signal bandwidth is within the coherence bandwidth, it is flat. p.31 defines BC through the Fourier transform of the delay profile and gives no constant in front of 1/σ, so BC ≈ 1/σ is only an order of magnitude: use it only to estimate BC and to say "the larger σ, the smaller BC"; do not use it to turn Bs/BC into σ/Ts and then apply 0.1. If the question gives σ, use σ/Ts < 0.1; if the question gives BC, compare Bs with BC directly: 2025-26 S1 Q2(b) gives both BC = 30 kHz and a maximum delay spread of 10 µs; (i) directly uses subcarrier bandwidth 500/N < 30 kHz to get N > 16.67 → Nmin = 17 (then 500/17 = 29.4 kHz, only slightly below 30 kHz, but by Bs < BC it counts as flat; it is an OFDM question, but flatness is judged the same way); 10 µs is the maximum delay, not σ; it is for setting the guard interval in (ii), not for judging flatness. Questions often say assume T = 1/B.
讲义 p.33；老师说这是蓝框公式，要背（发布的讲义 PDF 这一页看不到框，以: Notes p.33; the lecturer said this is a blue-box formula to memorise (the box is not visible on this page of the released PDF; go by the class recording). Used in reverse: \(T_s\gt 10\,\sigma_{T_m}\), i.e. \(R_s\lt 0.1/\sigma_{T_m}\); the result is an upper limit. Between 0.1 and ≫ 1 is a grey zone: the lecturer said in class that if the ratio is only slightly above 0.1 (e.g. 0.15) you cannot conclude; it must be much larger than 0.1 to call it frequency-selective. Compare the rms delay spread, not the maximum delay spread.
讲义 p.34–35。v 用 m/s（km/h ÷ 3.6），f<sub>c</: Notes p.34–35. v in m/s (km/h ÷ 3.6), f<sub>c</sub> in Hz. f<sub>m</sub> also appears in the LCR/AFD formulas (given in the exam); the lecturer expects you to say that it is the maximum Doppler shift.
讲义 p.34。θ &lt; 90°（迎着电波走）为正，θ &gt; 90° 为: Notes p.34. θ < 90° (moving towards the wave) is positive, θ > 90° is negative, θ = 90° (moving sideways) is 0. The lecturer said the Doppler shift itself is not a distortion; the Doppler spread is (frequency dispersion).
讲义 p.35 原话：TDMA 的保护时间和控制比特比 FDMA 的保护带占用更: Notes p.35 says: TDMA guard times and control bits use less capacity than FDMA guard bands. In higher bands such as Ku and K, narrow beams also allow multi-beam reuse.
讲义 p.36：信道冲激响应基本不变的时长。动得越快，f<sub>m</sub>: Notes p.36: the time over which the channel impulse response stays essentially unchanged. The faster you move, the larger f<sub>m</sub> and the shorter T<sub>C</sub>; when stationary (time-invariant channel) f<sub>m</sub> = 0 and T<sub>C</sub> → ∞.
讲义 p.37：符号时长比相干时间短、或信号带宽远大于多普勒扩展 → 一个符号内: Notes p.37: symbol duration shorter than the coherence time, or signal bandwidth much larger than the Doppler spread → amplitude and phase roughly constant within one symbol, slow fading; coherence time smaller than the symbol duration → fast fading. Because B<sub>s</sub> ≈ 1/T<sub>s</sub> and B<sub>D</sub> ≈ 1/T<sub>C</sub>, the time-domain and frequency-domain statements are equivalent. The lecturer's simple version: if the symbol duration is within the coherence time, it is slow fading.

讲义 p.45–47 例题印的 AFD = 71.17 µs、每秒 9812 个: The worked example on notes p.45–47 prints AFD = 71.17 µs and 9812 errors per second; by the notes' own formula it is 72.17 µs and 9950 (9812 = 137.87 × 71.17, i.e. multiplied using the misprinted AFD). In the exam, compute from the formula yourself.
讲义 p.45：两个节点之间信道够好就<b>单跳</b>直连；否则就要<b>多跳: Notes p.45: if the channel between two nodes is good enough they connect directly in a single hop; otherwise multi-hop is needed, with intermediate nodes relaying. The defining feature of an ad hoc network is that every node must be able to act as a router at any time. The chosen path must have no loops; only such a path is called a "route".
讲义 p.47 写的是 AFD = 71.17 µs、每秒 9812 个错误。按: Notes p.47 gives AFD = 71.17 µs and 9812 errors per second. Computing exactly with the notes' own formula gives 72.17 µs and 9950 per second. Cross-check another way: errors per second = fraction of time below threshold × symbol rate = \((1-e^{-0.01})\times10^6=9950\), consistent with 72.17 µs. In the exam, just compute with the formula yourself; the difference is small.
讲义 p.51，老师说\"有点难记，但要尽量记\"；记不住就用上一条现推。讲义写: Notes p.51; the lecturer says it is "a bit hard to remember, but try to memorise it"; if you cannot, derive it on the spot from the previous item. The notes write it as γ̄<sub>dB</sub> − γ<sub>AWGN,dB</sub>: a non-fading AWGN channel needs only SNR = γ<sub>0</sub>, while a Rayleigh channel needs FM more. It depends only on ε, not on γ̄: ε = 10% → 9.77 dB, 5% → 12.90 dB, 1% → 19.98 dB, 0.5% → 23.00 dB, 0.1% → 30.00 dB. Each 10× stricter outage requirement adds 10 dB of margin.
讲义 p.5–6：每根接收天线收到的是所有发射天线信号的加权和，再加上自己的噪声: Notes p.5–6: each receive antenna gets a weighted sum of all transmit-antenna signals plus its own noise: yi = Σj hijxj + vi. Stacking these into column vectors gives y = Hx + v. Rows of H correspond to receive antennas, columns to transmit antennas. The lecturer said you must be able to write this relation down directly, both element by element and in matrix form.

讲义定义（p.48）：隐藏节点是<b>在目的站范围内、但在发送站范围外</b>的: Definition in the notes (p.48): a hidden node is a node within range of the destination but out of range of the sender. 讲义没给子载波间隔。LTE 的子载波间隔是 15 kHz，一个 RB 宽 12: The notes do not give the subcarrier spacing. LTE subcarrier spacing is 15 kHz, so one RB is 12 × 15 = 180 kHz wide and a 20 MHz bandwidth holds 100 RBs. Each millisecond (one subframe) has 100 × 168 = 16,800 REs. With 64-QAM each RE carries 6 bits: 16,800 × 6 bit / 1 ms = 100.8 Mbps, the raw rate of one spatial stream; four streams of 4×4 MIMO give about 403 Mbps. After subtracting reference signals, control channels and coding redundancy, this is exactly the "above 300 Mbps" in the notes. It is an instance of Part 2 Ch. 5: "MIMO capacity grows linearly with min(N, M)".

讲义第 1b 章 p.5–9。\"或\"用加法（减掉被数了两次的交集），\"且\: Ch. 1b of the notes, p.5–9. "Or" uses addition (subtract the intersection, which was counted twice); "and" uses multiplication. You can multiply directly only if the events are independent (do not affect each other): two independent links each in outage 10% of the time are in outage together 0.1 × 0.1 = 0.01 of the time; in Practice 2 Q2(b) the shadowing at the two base stations is independent, so \(P_{out}=Q(\Delta/\sigma)\cdot Q(\Delta/\sigma)=[Q(\Delta/\sigma)]^2\). Mutually exclusive (cannot happen together) means \(P(A\cap B)=0\), which is not the same as independent.

讲义第 2 章 p.41–43。考试会给公式，但不一定解释符号：老师要求会说出: Ch. 2 of the notes p.41–43. Quick method: first compute the common denominator √(2π) f<sub>m</sub> ρ (√(2π) = 2.5066; keep one extra digit in intermediate values so the last digit of the result is not off by 1), then AFD = (e<sup>ρ²</sup> − 1) ÷ denominator and LCR = denominator × e<sup>−ρ²</sup>. 这就是<b>蜂窝（cellular）</b>这个概念要解决的核心问题：怎么用有限: This is the core problem the cellular concept solves: how to serve an almost unlimited, growing number of users with limited frequency resources. The answer is surprisingly simple: instead of one big tower, use many small towers, each covering only a small area. This one change leads to almost everything in the first part of this course: how the small towers are laid out (hexagonal geometry), how neighbouring towers avoid interfering with each other (frequency reuse and co-channel interference), how to squeeze in more when frequencies run out (cell splitting, sectoring), and how to keep a call going when a phone moves from one tower's area to another's (handoff).

问题不在信号能不能传那么远——功率开得足够大，物理上当然可以。问题在于<b>无线: The problem is not whether the signal can travel that far: with enough power it physically can. The problem is that radio frequency is a resource, and a limited one. Think of it as a road: the number of lanes is fixed, and each lane can carry only one car at a time. With a single tower for the whole city, the number of "lanes" (frequency channels) that can be used at once is fixed, say only 1000 calls at a time. When the 1001st person makes a call, the system tells them: "All lines are busy, please try again later".

Fog computing: distribute data management as close to the network edge as possible; any device with compute, storage and network connectivity can be a fog node. Analysing data near where it is produced cuts latency, offloads traffic from the core network and keeps sensitive data local (p.106).
问题：相对地面运动快，多普勒频移大；大气阻力大，轨道逐渐衰退；需要多个轨道面、每: Problems: fast motion relative to the ground, so large Doppler shift; high atmospheric drag, so the orbit gradually decays; many orbital planes with many satellites per plane are needed; communication between two places often needs handoffs between satellites (p.17). Advantages: for the same transmit power the signal is much stronger than from GEO; coverage is more local, which saves spectrum; suitable for handheld terminals (p.18). Little LEO: below 1 GHz, bandwidth under 5 MHz, rates up to 10 kbps, used for paging, tracking and low-rate messaging; Big LEO: above 1 GHz, up to a few Mbps, also offers voice and positioning (p.19).

频谱是运营商真金白银买来的稀缺资源，那么很自然会问：<b>同样一段频谱，到底能撑: Spectrum is a scarce resource that operators pay real money for, so the natural question is: how many calls can a given piece of spectrum actually carry? This measure is called spectral efficiency. The course splits it into two independent parts, one for "how modulation divides channels" and one for "how the multiple-access scheme shares resources":
频谱是运营商花大钱买来的。<b>频谱效率</b>回答一个问题：每 1 MHz 频: Operators pay a lot of money for spectrum. Spectral efficiency answers one question: per 1 MHz of spectrum and per 1 km² of area, how many calls can be supported? Part A p.38–39 of the notes splits it into two parts: modulation spectral efficiency ηm and multiple access spectral efficiency ηa; overall efficiency η = ηm × ηa (p.46).
频谱有限，用户很多。信道分配（channel assignment）决定\"哪个: Spectrum is limited and users are many. Channel assignment decides "which cell may use which channels"; a good assignment lets the same spectrum carry more calls (Part A p.92). There are two basic methods: fixed channel assignment (FCA) and dynamic channel assignment (DCA).
频谱有限，用户很多。多址技术就是规定\"许多用户怎样同时共用一段频谱而不互相干扰: Spectrum is limited and users are many. A multiple access technique defines "how many users share one band of spectrum at the same time without interfering with each other". The method is to divide some resource among the users: divide frequency, divide time, or let everyone use the same frequency at the same time and separate them by code (definition on notes Part A p.7; p.15–26 introduce the 1G–3G systems).
